title: A thread switch is really done fast
why: Owner target: a thread switch, first visit and revisit, is really done (field-latency contentDone) in a median of 100 ms. Field p50 revisit today: painted 204-536 ms, really done 715-1651 ms per device. Sandy has no holons for the parts this touches yet; this change set adds them and the requirement the first change must meet.

holon.title: Sandy
holon.why: The owner runs coding agents in threads from one place and wants it to feel like a fast local tool on every device he uses.
holon.contract: Sandy shows projects, threads and their agents in a browser or desktop app served by a server and host daemons.

holon.title: Sandy app
holon.why: People read and steer their threads in the browser, on the desktop and on the phone.
holon.contract: The web client renders the sidebar, the thread view and plugin slots from server data and switches threads without a page load.

holon.title: Thread view
holon.why: Switching between threads is what the owner does most; a slow or still-changing view after a switch is the lag he feels.
holon.contract: Shows a thread's timeline, composer and status for the thread in the route, and after a switch shows its content without later changes.

holon.title: Field latency
holon.why: Lab numbers differ from what the owner feels; only samples from his own browsers per device show whether a change helps.
holon.contract: Records menu, dialog and thread-switch latency in the owner's browsers per device, including when the thread view stopped changing after a switch, and reports percentiles per device and release.

seams.contract: Times a switch until the thread view is painted and until its content stopped changing

requirement.title: Last content writer is named
requirement.shall: For each thread switch with a content-done mark, the collector SHALL record which plugin made the last content change after the ready paint, named by the data-sandy-plugin of its nearest plugin root, or host when no plugin root encloses it, and how many content changes followed the ready paint, and the report SHALL show per device each last writer's share of switches and content p50, so the field gap between painted and really done is attributed.

scenarios.title: Plugin writes last
scenarios.when: a switch is ready and 300 ms later a content change happens inside a plugin root of the plugin genui, after a host change at 100 ms
scenarios.then: the sample's contentSource is genui and its contentWrites is 2
scenarios.test: ci extensions/sandy/field-latency/collector.test.ts::the plugin that writes last after ready is the sample's content source

scenarios.title: Host ticker capped
scenarios.when: after the ready paint a host element in the content changes every 900 ms until the 5 s cap
scenarios.then: the sample has contentDone capped, contentSource host and contentWrites of at least 4
scenarios.test: ci extensions/sandy/field-latency/collector.test.ts::a host ticker after ready is named as the content source of a capped switch

scenarios.title: Nothing after ready
scenarios.when: a switch is ready and no content change follows before it settles
scenarios.then: the sample has contentSource null and contentWrites 0
scenarios.test: ci extensions/sandy/field-latency/collector.test.ts::a switch with no content change after ready has no content source

scenarios.title: Report per writer
scenarios.when: the report runs over switch samples of two devices whose last writers are genui, host and none
scenarios.then: each device lists every last writer with its share of that device's switches and its content p50, none for samples without a writer
scenarios.test: ci extensions/sandy/field-latency/server.test.ts::the switch report shows per device the share and content p50 of each last writer

scenarios.title: Old samples unknown
scenarios.when: the report runs over switch samples stored before contentSource existed
scenarios.then: they report under the writer unknown and their ready and content numbers are unchanged
scenarios.test: ci extensions/sandy/field-latency/server.test.ts::samples stored without a content source report under the unknown writer

question.text: The lab explains only 7-54 ms of the 0.5-1.1 s field gap between painted and really done. Ship this attribution and collect a day of field data per device before the first speed change to the thread view?
